page.layout: One page of text, blank or nearly blank. No readable printed blocks, no margin notes, no running head, no page number.
page.notes: The scan shows only faint, washed-out blotches and specks of show-through and stains across the sheet. No legible printed words can be made out in any line, so no text is transcribed. The faint horizontal bands of marks are not readable letters and are treated as show-through or staining.
